contract: assert brace expansion matches js and ts suffixes while rejecting other extensions
assert partial matching treats ancestor paths as in-progress matches for a deeper glob, while the same path fails without partial mode
assert Minimatch.hasMagic leaves brace alternation non-magical by default and only counts it as magic when magicalBraces is enabled
assert minimatch.filter keeps only the values that satisfy the pattern in input order

assert minimatch.escape wraps wildcard characters in a character class under windowsPathsNoEscape, minimatch.unescape restores the literal backslash form, and the escaped pattern matches the slash-normalized path
case.goal: Match glob patterns with minimatch 10, including brace expansion, partial matching, magical pattern detection, and Windows path escaping
